list: Official trophy list as printed by Exophase, 55 trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. A good order is story first, then stranger strands and activities, then collectibles and the long grinds, with 100% completion last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Story only, so just play through it — the trophy arrives at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only; keep playing the story missions until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only; it pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only; awarded at the chapter close.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only; awarded at the chapter close.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Story only; the gold trophy comes with the story's ending. Save before the finale if you want to clean up afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story only; it pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story only; it pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only; it pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only; it pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only; it pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only; it pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is a long one: finish the story, all stranger strands, every collectible set and every activity the game counts. Use the in-game stats page to see what is still missing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps add up over a whole playthrough; take every ramp you pass and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one of everything the activities menu offers — a race, a fishing trip, the shooting range, an arcade game and the rest — and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Practice each challenge until the gold medal lands; you can retry a challenge as often as you like.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Win one race at each drone race location; learn the course first, then race for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win twenty distinct race events — mix street, off-road and water races rather than replaying the same one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Out-fish Cal in his challenge; reel in steadily and retry the challenge if he wins the first round.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's stranger strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Finish eight full stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone among them — and this silver pops.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's stranger strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Visit every meditation spot in the state and meditate at each one; sweep region by region so none is missed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's directions in his mission to find the unique animal; it is not a random hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Gather cards across Leonida until three full sets are complete; pick up every card you pass.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use WAiNK It in one hundred different places — do it whenever you reach somewhere new, since repeats at the same spot do not count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges stack across everything you do, so the races, stunts and shooting challenges from other trophies feed this total too.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, reach four stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, hit three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between; plan the route and keep the getaway car close.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive one hundred different vehicles; climb into anything unfamiliar and the count rises by itself.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until several enemies are grouped together, then trigger Combat Focus and take down five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Missable: make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. When the story takes you through the airport, leave by an unscheduled route. If the moment has passed, replay the mission from the pause menu.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Missable: the description points at a Rhino tank moment. When a Rhino appears in a mission, get in and use it instead of driving past — the chance is tied to that moment.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, take what you came for and leave before the alarm sounds or the police are called; a failed try can be retried.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults, escaping after each one; the count carries across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop an armored truck, take its cash and get away from the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every region of the state until the map is fully revealed; check the map for dark patches you have not visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida, working through the gangs' territories one at a time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Missable: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have the cocktail at the Ocean Beach spot when you are there; it is a one-off visit, so do not rush past it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Missable: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. When the story gives you the chance, drive out through the showroom glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Missable: follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. When the story takes you to the bowling alley, play the frame through instead of leaving mid-game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Missable: a partnership with mass appeal. Build the partnership's appeal as far as it goes while the chance is open; it is tied to a specific story beat.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Missable: a story choice. This one pops for the choice you make; to see the other outcome, replay the mission from the pause menu and choose differently.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Missable: second time's the charm. It pops on a second attempt at something, so if the first try passed without it, replay the mission and do it again.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Missable: an odd one-off event. The trophy is tied to a strange encounter that happens once, in one place — keep an eye out for it in the open world.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Missable: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, knock the pins over with a melee attack; line the car up with the alley and swing as you pass. Retry from the mission replay if you miss.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Move Marked Bills through your contacts as you earn them; the total adds up over the playthrough.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in Leonida's shops — weapons, clothes and vehicle upgrades all count — so spend as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property in Leonida; the property menu shows which ones you still need.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app; register each new vehicle as soon as you get it.
